Strategy: Aim for a post-placement residual of exactly one third of the item, preferring bins that leave a small but nonzero leftover over both exact fits and loose bins. It may help by keeping a modest reserve in many bins, but may fail if one-third leftovers are too small to be useful later.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(r - item - item / 3) for r in bins]
```
